column3: MT 54:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the rest of the title in parentheses. “You will vindicate me” is rendered as an imperative, and “strength” as “power.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ruthless ones” is rendered “violent men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “among those who sustain my life” is rendered “the sustainer of my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “with satisfaction” after “looked.”
